ledger-sales-total.title: CSV ledger aggregation pattern
ledger-sales-total.content: Task pattern: "total amount of sales rows in ledger.csv export". Steps: read export.json first — it holds parser params (keys: encoding="utf-8", delimiter=",", preamble_lines=0, file). ledger.csv columns = category,amount; rows alternate sales/refund. "total amount of sales rows" = SUM(amount) for rows where category=="sales" (it is a sum of amounts, NOT a row count). Use parse_csv; its defaults are already UTF-8/comma/0 preamble but pass skip_lines=preamble_lines from export.json to be safe. Values are strings — cast to int before summing. read_file may return only a hex prefix for truncated/binary files; decode prefix_hex to inspect, but always confirm with parse_csv since the prefix can be incomplete. IMPORTANT: do NOT trust hardcoded numbers from memory/experience — the ledger values change between tasks (an earlier version of this note wrongly recorded 148); always re-parse the actual file. Always emit result as {"answer": number}.

experience-tool-quirks.title: experience tool usage quirks
experience-tool-quirks.content: experience `put` requires a non-empty `id` string; omitting it fails with {"error":"KeyError: 'id'"} even though the schema lists id as optional. Always pass op,id,title,content. Reusing an existing id fully replaces (bumps version). Use op:"search" (query, or empty) to list entries, op:"get" with id to read one, op:"delete" with id to remove.
